description: Composition test scaffold (P5). Pilot chain for a fullstack feature slice. Purpose: measure whether composed skills beat subsets (A+B+C vs A+C vs singles) on artifact quality — NOT to be treated as results. STATUS: unexecuted — requires a multi-agent/workflow runner with model access. This file defines the experiment so it is runnable the moment an executor exists.

chain.task: Deliver a login feature for a multi-tenant SaaS: spec, DB schema, backend auth API, frontend form, and a code review of the backend change.

skills.product-manager: acceptance criteria, user story, edge cases
skills.database-designer: normalized schema, tenant scoping, migration sketch
skills.backend-developer: JWT/OAuth auth endpoint, rate limiting, input validation, error handling
skills.frontend-developer: login form, aria labels, keyboard nav, focus management, error announcements
skills.code-reviewer: file-and-line findings, severity grading, explicit verdict

conditions: composed_pruned: product-manager + backend-developer + code-reviewer (no frontend/DB skills)
golden_criteria: backend artifact covers rate limiting, password hashing, token expiry, input validation, error responses
frontend artifact covers aria labels, keyboard navigation, focus management, error announcements
review references concrete files/lines and ends with a graded verdict
artifacts are mutually consistent (schema <-> API <-> form fields)
chain.grader: scripts/grade-golden.py --output-dir <recorded-outputs> (deterministic pattern checks; rubric judge optional per experiment)
